title: Delivery & Technical Support Engineer
description:
**About Us**

Founded in 2003, **JNR Management Resources Pvt. Ltd.** is a trusted leader in **cybersecurity and IT solutions**, helping organizations protect digital assets and secure sensitive information. With 20+ years of expertise, we deliver end-to-end services including **regulatory compliance, data privacy, advanced hardware security modules, and digital protection consulting**. Our solutions ensure robust security, compliance with **GDPR & RBI regulations**, and secure digital transformation for clients across industries.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a technically skilled Delivery & Technical Support Engineer to implement, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot PKI, CLM, TLM, SSL/TLS certificates, HSM, and digital signing solutions.

The candidate will be responsible for technical implementation, customer support, certificate management, issue resolution, and coordination with internal teams and technology vendors.

Key ResponsibilitiesImplementation & Delivery

* Install, configure, and implement PKI, CLM, TLM, and certificate management solutions.
* Support SSL/TLS certificate installation, renewal, replacement, and troubleshooting.
* Assist with certificate lifecycle management and automation.
* Configure certificate integrations with web servers, application servers, and relevant enterprise systems.
* Support digital signing, encryption, and HSM-related implementation activities as applicable.
* Prepare implementation documents, configuration records, and handover reports.
* Conduct customer training and knowledge-transfer sessions.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

* Provide L1/L2 technical support for deployed cybersecurity solutions.
* Troubleshoot certificate errors, expiry issues, certificate-chain problems, and configuration failures.
* Investigate CSR, SSL/TLS, certificate validation, and connectivity-related issues.
* Support certificate renewals, replacements, and revocation-related activities.
* Coordinate with vendors, Certificate Authorities, and internal teams to resolve complex issues.
* Maintain support tickets and provide timely updates to customers.
* Document recurring issues, root causes, and resolutions.
* Support product upgrades, maintenance, and technical health checks.

Required Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 2–6 years of relevant experience in technical delivery, implementation, or support.
* Practical knowledge of PKI, CLM, TLM, SSL/TLS certificates, and digital certificates.
* Understanding of X.509, CSR, certificate chains, Root CA, Intermediate CA, CRL, and OCSP.
* Knowledge of RSA/ECC, public and private keys, and cryptographic fundamentals.
* Familiarity with Windows Server, Linux, OpenSSL, Microsoft IIS, Apache, or Nginx.
* Basic understanding of certificate automation and API-based integrations.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and customer communication skills.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with Microsoft AD CS and enterprise certificate management platforms.
* Exposure to HSM and cryptographic key management.
* Knowledge of digital signatures, encryption, and certificate deployment.
* Ability to work with customers remotely and at customer locations when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Successful implementation and delivery of solutions.
* Technical issue resolution time and support quality.
* Customer satisfaction and service quality.
* Accuracy of technical documentation.
* Timely completion of implementation activities.
* Successful upgrades, renewals, and coordination with vendors and internal teams.

Job Type: Permanent

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Language:

* English (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: System Administrator II
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!  
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

This role is responsible for the implementation, support, and troubleshooting of server systems, including operating systems, software, compute servers, storage, virtualization, email, Active Directory, and cloud infrastructure. The role has a primary sourcing focus on **AWS experience**, along with Azure, VMware, and other enterprise infrastructure technologies.

**Work Requirements:**

This is a hybrid model role, requiring employees to work from the office 2 to 3 days per week at Mohan Estate, Delhi.

**Work Location:** New Delhi

The position follows a five-day workweek. Working hours or days may vary as per work requirements.

Technical Skill Set:

**Cloud Environment AWS (Primary Expertise), Azure and VMware (Mandatory Skillsets)**

Strong hands-on experience with AWS is the primary sourcing preference for this role. Experience with Azure and VMware is also required as part of the broader cloud and infrastructure skill set. Candidates with AWS as their primary cloud platform and additional Azure experience are preferred.

**Servers:** Windows Server 2022, 2016 Datacenter, DNS, DHCP Server, Web Server IIS, SQL Server 2016, VMware, Virtual Server, ESXi Server, Monitoring Server, etc.

**Directory Services:** Active Directory Server 2022 & 2016.

**Web Server:** IIS Server, FTP Server, SMTP Server, etc.

**Mail Server:** Microsoft Exchange Server, Office 365, etc.

**Operating System:** Windows 11 Enterprise.

**Application Software:** All Windows applications, software, and Linux applications.

**MS Tech:** DNS, DHCP, AD, DC, VPN, Proxy Server, Backup Utilities, Print and File Server.

**IT Skills:** Servers, Server Load Balancing, Server Configuration & Management, LAN, WAN, VLAN, Routing, Antivirus Server and Client Deployment.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Implement, upgrade, maintain, and troubleshoot server systems, including operating systems, software, compute servers, storage, virtualization, email, Active Directory, and cloud.
* Monitor and troubleshoot server performance, including availability, capacity, and utilization.
* Procure server equipment and manage subcontractors involved with server installations.
* Provide server technical support directly to users and through ticketing systems.
* Create technical support documentation for server systems and processes.
* Coordinate additional resources needed to accomplish tasks and projects.
* Develop, implement, and maintain policies and procedures.
* Escalate service requests as needed to meet client expectations.
* Participate in supporting server projects and initiatives.
* Provide on-call and remote troubleshooting support as needed.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience with computer servers, storage, VMware, Exchange, Active Directory, Antivirus, Group Policy, and backup software.
* Professional IT certifications in Microsoft, VMware, and AWS preferred.

**Required Skills**

* Ability to implement, administer, and troubleshoot server infrastructure, including operating systems, software, compute servers, storage, virtualization, and cloud.
* Ability to manage small projects and work in a team or independently under minimal supervision.
* In-depth knowledge of server infrastructure, including operating systems, software, compute servers, storage, virtualization, and cloud.
* In-depth knowledge of Active Directory, GPO, DNS, and DHCP.
* In-depth knowledge of Disaster Recovery / Business Continuity Planning and testing.
* Ability to work in a team or independently under minimal supervision.
* Good problem-solving, communication, time management, and organizational skills.
* Knowledge of Symantec, Veeam, NetBackup, Citrix, AWS, Nutanix, and Azure preferred.
* Knowledge of SharePoint, sFTP, Windows printer servers, routers, SolarWinds, and Wireshark preferred.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently.
* Ability to provide off-hours support for implementations, upgrades, testing, and troubleshooting.

Job Description – L1 Desktop Support Engineer

**Position:** L1 Desktop Support Engineer  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Location:** \[Delhi NCR / ]  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for an **L1 Desktop Support Engineer** to provide first\-level technical support to users and ensure smooth availability of IT infrastructure at office and client locations.

The role will involve **desktop/laptop support, Windows troubleshooting, LAN/Wi\-Fi support, printers, basic server support, ticket management, and field visits** as required.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide **L1 technical support** for desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT peripherals.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot **Windows 10/11 operating systems, drivers, applications, and updates**.
* Troubleshoot basic **LAN, Wi\-Fi, Internet, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP** connectivity issues.
* Perform basic troubleshooting of **network switches, routers, access points, and other network devices**.
* Configure and troubleshoot **printers, scanners, and other office peripherals**.
* Provide basic support for **servers**, including connectivity checks, service/status monitoring, user access, and escalation of server\-related issues.
* Handle **IT incidents and service requests through the ticketing system** and ensure timely updates and closure.
* Maintain proper documentation of troubleshooting performed and actions taken.
* Escalate unresolved issues to **L2/L3 teams or vendors** with complete troubleshooting details.
* Assist with **new user setup**, including system configuration, application installation, email/account setup, and peripheral allocation.
* Assist in **IT asset installation, movement, replacement, and inventory management**.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware repairs, warranty support, and replacement of faulty equipment.
* Visit **client / branch / site locations** for installation, troubleshooting, maintenance, and resolution of IT\-related issues.
* Ensure timely resolution of issues and minimize downtime for users and business operations.
* Follow company IT policies, security procedures, and defined **SLA/ticket resolution timelines**.

Technical Skills Required

* Good hands\-on knowledge of **Windows 10/11 troubleshooting**.
* Basic knowledge of **computer hardware, desktops, laptops, and peripherals**.
* Good understanding of **LAN, Wi\-Fi, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP**.
* Basic knowledge of **network switches, routers, and access points**.
* Hands\-on experience with **printer and scanner troubleshooting**.
* Basic understanding of **server infrastructure and server troubleshooting**.
* Familiarity with **IT helpdesk / ticketing systems**.
* Basic knowledge of **Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365**.
* Basic understanding of **Active Directory and user account management** will be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of antivirus/endpoint security and system updates.

Field Support

* Willingness to **travel to client and branch locations** for technical support.
* Carry out on\-site troubleshooting, installation, configuration, and maintenance activities.
* Coordinate with client representatives and internal teams to resolve technical issues.
* Maintain professional communication and service standards while working at client locations.

Candidate Profile

* **1–2 years of experience** in Desktop Support / IT Support / Technical Support.
* Diploma / Graduate in **IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field**.
* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Customer\-service\-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently and handle multiple tickets/issues.
* **Willingness to travel for field visits is mandatory.**
* Candidates with hands\-on experience at **client sites / multiple locations** will be preferred.
